11.name: What Transporting Entails
11.description: Certain duties require the transporting of items to a designated location.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>While carrying out such tasks, use of actions will be restricted, and you will be granted the <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Transporting<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> status effect.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>You must be wary of attacks, as they will sap your strength.
11.translation_description: Alcuni incarichi richiedono di trasportare oggetti in un luogo designato.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Durante queste attività, l'uso delle azioni sarà limitato e riceverai l'effetto di stato <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Trasporto<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Fai attenzione agli attacchi, perché indeboliranno le tue forze.

12.name: Losing the Transporting Status
12.description: You will lose the Transporting status when the effect duration expires or you change areas. In such cases, you may return to the starting location and begin anew.
12.translation_description: Perderai lo stato di Trasporto quando la sua durata scadrà o cambierai area. In tal caso, puoi tornare al punto di partenza e ricominciare.

13.name: What Transparent Entails
13.description: During certain duties, you may gain the <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Transparent<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> status effect, which restricts available actions but allows you to pass by most enemies undetected. Use this invisible state to reach your destination before the effect expires.
13.translation_description: Durante alcuni incarichi potresti ricevere l'effetto di stato <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Invisibilità<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, che limita le azioni disponibili ma ti permette di passare inosservato davanti alla maggior parte dei nemici. Sfrutta questo stato per raggiungere la destinazione prima che l'effetto scada.

14.name: Losing the Transparent Status
14.description: You will lose the Transparent status when the effect duration expires or you change areas, causing nearby enemies to detect you and preventing quest progression.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>You may return to the starting location at any time to refresh the duration of the Transparent status. If it has already expired, it will be granted anew.
14.translation_description: Perderai lo stato di Invisibilità quando la sua durata scadrà o cambierai area: i nemici vicini ti scopriranno e non potrai proseguire la missione.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Puoi tornare al punto di partenza in qualsiasi momento per ripristinare la durata dell'Invisibilità. Se è già scaduta, l'effetto ti verrà conferito di nuovo.

15.name: What Escorting Entails
15.description: Certain duties require that one or more NPCs accompany you in order to proceed with quest objectives.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>You must keep them at your side and make your way to a designated location.
15.translation_description: Alcuni incarichi richiedono che uno o più PNG ti accompagnino per portare avanti gli obiettivi della missione.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Devi tenerli al tuo fianco e raggiungere un luogo designato.

16.name: What Escorting Entails
16.description: So long as you remain in the same area, NPCs accompanying you will remain at your side even when using Teleport or the Aethernet.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>It is possible to ride mounts or swim while escorting NPCs. Please note, however, they will not appear at your side until you dismount or leave the water.
16.translation_description: Finché resti nella stessa area, i PNG che ti accompagnano rimarranno al tuo fianco anche quando usi Teletrasporto o Eternet.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Puoi cavalcare o nuotare mentre scorti i PNG. Tieni presente, però, che non ti appariranno accanto finché non smonterai o non uscirai dall'acqua.

17.name: What Escorting Entails
17.description: You may also speak with NPCs while escorting them. Furthermore, you may encounter “conversation points” along the way which offer additional topics of discussion. These points will also be indicated on your map.
17.translation_description: Puoi anche parlare con i PNG mentre li scorti. Inoltre, lungo il percorso potresti trovare «punti di conversazione» che offrono altri argomenti di cui parlare. Questi punti saranno indicati anche sulla mappa.

18.name: Parting Ways with NPCs
18.description: When speaking with NPCs, you will be given the option to part ways. You will also part ways automatically when changing areas.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>If you part ways with an NPC, you may return to the starting point and speak with them to try again.
18.translation_description: Quando parli con un PNG, potrai scegliere di separarti da lui. Vi separerete automaticamente anche quando cambierai area.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Se ti separi da un PNG, puoi tornare al punto di partenza e parlargli per riprovare.

19.name: What Following Entails
19.description: Certain duties require you to follow an NPC to a designated location. Should you fall too far behind, the NPC will return to the starting point, and you must speak with them to try again.
19.translation_description: Alcuni incarichi richiedono di seguire un PNG fino a un luogo designato. Se rimani troppo indietro, il PNG tornerà al punto di partenza e dovrai parlargli per riprovare.

20.name: What Sneaking Entails
20.description: Certain duties require you to follow an NPC and approach without being seen. Should you be detected, you must return to the starting point and try again.
20.translation_description: Alcuni incarichi richiedono di seguire un PNG e avvicinarti senza farti vedere. Se vieni scoperto, dovrai tornare al punto di partenza e riprovare.

21.name: Avoiding Detection
21.description: The indicator shown in the image above indicates that you risk being seen should the NPC you're following turn around.
21.translation_description: L'indicatore mostrato nell'immagine qui sopra indica che rischi di farti vedere se il PNG che stai seguendo si volta.

22.name: Avoiding Detection
22.description: The indicator shown in the image above indicates that you risk being seen should you be standing too close to the NPC.
22.translation_description: L'indicatore mostrato nell'immagine qui sopra indica che rischi di farti vedere se ti trovi troppo vicino al PNG.

23.name: What Transformation Entails
23.description: Certain duties require you to transform into creatures or other people, restricting available actions. These transformations only last a limited time, indicated by the <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Transfiguration<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> status effect.
23.translation_description: Alcuni incarichi richiedono di trasformarti in creature o altre persone, limitando le azioni disponibili. Queste trasformazioni durano solo per un periodo limitato, indicato dall'effetto di stato <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Trasfigurazione<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

24.name: Losing the Transfiguration Status
24.description: Should the Transfiguration status effect expire, or you stray too far from the objective, you will be returned to your original form.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>You may return to the starting location at any time to refresh the duration of the Transfiguration status. If it has already expired, it will be granted anew.
24.translation_description: Se l'effetto di stato Trasfigurazione scade o ti allontani troppo dall'obiettivo, tornerai alla tua forma originale.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Puoi tornare al punto di partenza in qualsiasi momento per ripristinare la durata della Trasfigurazione. Se è già scaduta, l'effetto ti verrà conferito di nuovo.

25.name: What Guises Entail
25.description: Certain duties require you to don a disguise to complete quest objectives. You may only remain disguised for a limited time, indicated by the <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Guise<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> status effect.
25.translation_description: Alcuni incarichi richiedono di travestirti per completare gli obiettivi della missione. Puoi restare travestito solo per un periodo limitato, indicato dall'effetto di stato <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Travestimento<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

26.name: Losing the Guise Status
26.description: Should the Guise status effect expire, or you stray too far from the objective, you will lose your disguise.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>You may return to the starting location at any time to refresh the duration of the Guise status. If it has already expired, it will be granted anew.
26.translation_description: Se l'effetto di stato Travestimento scade o ti allontani troppo dall'obiettivo, perderai il travestimento.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Puoi tornare al punto di partenza in qualsiasi momento per ripristinare la durata del Travestimento. Se è già scaduto, l'effetto ti verrà conferito di nuovo.

27.name: What Guarding Entails
27.description: Certain duties require that you escort an NPC to a designated location while guarding them from enemy attacks. Should you stray too far from the NPC or they are attacked, they will stop moving.
27.translation_description: Alcuni incarichi richiedono di scortare un PNG fino a un luogo designato e proteggerlo dagli attacchi nemici. Se ti allontani troppo dal PNG o viene attaccato, smetterà di muoversi.

28.name: Failing to Guard an NPC
28.description: The escort attempt will fail if the NPC is incapacitated, you stray too far from them, or you change areas. In the event of failure, you may return to the starting point and try again.
28.translation_description: Il tentativo di scorta fallirà se il PNG viene messo fuori combattimento, ti allontani troppo da lui o cambi area. Se fallisci, puoi tornare al punto di partenza e riprovare.

29.name: Step One: Accumulate 100 TP
29.description: To grasp the fundamentals of working with familiars, first try to complete an instinctual combo with your Cu Sith.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Familiars accumulate TP via their auto-attacks, and beastmasters accumulate TP by completing weaponskill combos. Once you and your Cu Sith each have 100 TP, you are ready to perform an instinctual combo.
29.translation_description: Per apprendere le basi del lavoro con i familiar, prova a completare una combo istintiva con il tuo Cu Sith.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>I familiar accumulano TP con gli attacchi automatici, mentre i domatori li accumulano completando combo di tecniche. Quando tu e il tuo Cu Sith avrete entrambi 100 TP, potrete eseguire una combo istintiva.

30.name: Step Two: Complete the Instinctual Combo
30.translation_name: Passo Due: Completa la Combo Istintiva
30.description: Order your Cu Sith to perform its <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Trick<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Then, <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>within seven seconds<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, execute the beastmaster action <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Avalanche Axe<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. This will complete a <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Rampant<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> instinctual combo!<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>You may complete instinctual combos with any familiar, and may trigger different actions depending on the skills used.
30.translation_description: Ordina al tuo Cu Sith di usare <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Trick<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Poi, <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>entro sette secondi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, usa l'azione del domatore <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Avalanche Axe<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. In questo modo completerai una combo istintiva <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Rampant<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Puoi completare combo istintive con qualsiasi familiar; le azioni che si attivano dipendono dalle tecniche che usi.

31.name: Working in Tandem
31.description: By working together, a beastmaster and their familiar can chain <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>instinctual skills<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, which expend TP, to complete special combos that deal additional damage. Either a beastmaster or their familiar can be first to strike, but the combo must be completed <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>within seven seconds<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
31.translation_description: Lavorando insieme, un domatore e il suo familiar possono concatenare <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>abilità istintive<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, che consumano TP, per completare combo speciali che infliggono danni aggiuntivi. Può attaccare per primo il domatore o il familiar, ma la combo va completata <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>entro sette secondi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

32.name: That Striking Dummy's Always Looking at Me...
32.translation_name: Quel Manichino da Allenamento mi Fissa Sempre...
32.description: Attacking a striking dummy will pull its attention and engage you in combat. When you have finished practice, target the striking dummy and select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Reset Striking Dummy Enmity<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> via the subcommand menu to put it to rest.
32.translation_description: Attaccando un manichino da allenamento attirerai la sua attenzione e inizierai a combattere. Quando hai finito di allenarti, seleziona il manichino e scegli <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Azzera Ostilità del Manichino d'Allenamento<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> dal menu contestuale per riportarlo alla quiete.

33.name: Step One: Accumulate 100 TP
33.description: To extend your knowledge of working with familiars, first try to complete an intentional combo with your Cu Sith.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>As with instinctual combos, beastmasters and their familiars will each need to accumulate 100 TP. Complete beastmaster weaponskill combos and let your Cu Sith auto-attack until you both have 100 TP.
33.translation_description: Per approfondire il lavoro con i familiar, prova a completare una combo intenzionale con il tuo Cu Sith.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Come per le combo istintive, tu e il tuo familiar dovrete accumulare 100 TP. Completa combo di tecniche del domatore e lascia che il tuo Cu Sith esegua attacchi automatici finché entrambi non avrete 100 TP.

34.name: Step Two: Complete the Intentional Combo
34.translation_name: Passo Due: Completa la Combo Intenzionale
34.description: Order your Cu Sith to perform its <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Trick<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Then, <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>within seven seconds<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, execute the beastmaster action <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Mistral Axe<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. This will complete a <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Moonstalker<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> intentional combo!<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>You may complete intentional combos with any familiar, and may trigger a different action depending upon the skills used.
34.translation_description: Ordina al tuo Cu Sith di usare <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Trick<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Poi, <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>entro sette secondi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, usa l'azione del domatore <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Mistral Axe<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. In questo modo completerai una combo intenzionale <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Moonstalker<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Puoi completare combo intenzionali con qualsiasi familiar; le tecniche usate possono attivare azioni diverse.

35.name: Instinctual Affinities
35.description: The four basic instinctual affinities are as follows: <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Volant<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Rampant<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Durant<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, and <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Eldritch<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Both beastmaster and familiar skills possess these affinities, and understanding the impact they have on one another is crucial to advanced beastmastery. Instinctual affinities can be confirmed in a weaponskill's help text, or may be intuited from the icon.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>When instinctual affinities are connected in a certain order, they complete the aforementioned <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>intentional combos<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, which in turn have two additional instinctual affinities: <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Moonstalker<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Sunstrider<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
35.translation_description: Le quattro affinità istintive di base sono: <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Volant<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Rampant<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Durant<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Eldritch<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Le tecniche del domatore e del familiar possiedono queste affinità; comprenderne le interazioni è fondamentale per padroneggiare quest'arte. Puoi verificare l'affinità istintiva nel testo d'aiuto di una tecnica oppure intuirla dalla sua icona.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Collegando le affinità istintive in un ordine specifico si ottengono le già citate <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>combo intenzionali<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, che a loro volta hanno due affinità istintive aggiuntive: <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Moonstalker<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Sunstrider<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

36.name: Moonstalker
36.description: Gaining the effect of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Moonstalker<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> requires chaining the following instinctual affinities:<hex:02100103>　・<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Rampant<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> → <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Durant<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　・<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Eldritch<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> → <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Volant<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Your Cu Sith's <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Trick<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> has a <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Rampant<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> affinity, so when completed with <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Mistral Axe<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, it triggers a <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Moonstalker<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> intentional combo.
36.translation_description: Per ottenere l'effetto <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Moonstalker<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, devi concatenare le seguenti affinità istintive:<hex:02100103>　・<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Rampant<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> → <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Durant<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　・<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Eldritch<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> → <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Volant<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>La tecnica <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Trick<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> del tuo Cu Sith ha affinità <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Rampant<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>; completandola con <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Mistral Axe<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, attiverai una combo intenzionale <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Moonstalker<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

37.name: Sunstrider
37.description: Gaining the effect of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Sunstrider<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> requires chaining the following instinctual affinities:<hex:02100103>　・<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Volant<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> → <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Rampant<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　・<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Durant<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> → <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Eldritch<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>So long as instinctual affinities are performed in the designated order, it does not matter whether a beastmaster or familiar strikes first. In this case, since your Cu Sith's <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Trick<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> has a <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Rampant<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> affinity, preceding it with the beastmaster action <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Gale Axe<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will complete a <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Sunstrider<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> intentional combo.
37.translation_description: Per ottenere l'effetto <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Sunstrider<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, devi concatenare le seguenti affinità istintive:<hex:02100103>　・<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Volant<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> → <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Rampant<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　・<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Durant<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> → <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Eldritch<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Purché le affinità istintive seguano l'ordine indicato, non importa se attacca per primo il domatore o il familiar. In questo caso, dato che la tecnica <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Trick<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> del tuo Cu Sith ha affinità <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Rampant<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, usarla dopo l'azione del domatore <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Gale Axe<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> completerà una combo intenzionale <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Sunstrider<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

38.name: Step One: Accumulate Stacks of Mastered Instinct
38.translation_name: Passo Uno: Accumula Cumuli di Mastered Instinct
38.description: To perfect your synchronicity with your familiars, first try to complete an infinitive combo with your Cu Sith.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Spending three stacks of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Mastered Instinct<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> when executing <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Rally<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will instantly grant you 250 TP. You will need this later, so first accumulate three stacks of Mastered Instinct by completing instinctual or intentional combos with beastmaster skills. <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Your Cu Sith must attack first to accumulate stacks of Mastered Instinct.<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>
38.translation_description: Per perfezionare la sintonia con i tuoi familiar, prova a completare una combo infinitiva con il tuo Cu Sith.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Spendendo tre cumuli di <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Mastered Instinct<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> quando esegui <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Rally<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, otterrai subito 250 TP. Ti serviranno più avanti, quindi accumula tre cumuli di Mastered Instinct completando combo istintive o intenzionali con le tecniche del domatore. <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Per accumulare cumuli di Mastered Instinct, il tuo Cu Sith deve attaccare per primo.<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>

39.name: Step Two: Complete a <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Moonstalker<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> Intentional Combo
39.translation_name: Passo Due: Completa una Combo Intenzionale <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Moonstalker<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>
39.description: With three stacks of Mastered Instinct on hand, it's time for an intentional combo.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Order your Cu Sith to perform its <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Trick<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, then execute the beastmaster action <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Mistral Axe<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> to complete a <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Moonstalker<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> intentional combo.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>From this point, you will have seven seconds to complete the infinitive combo.<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> Move with haste!
39.translation_description: Ora che hai accumulato tre cumuli di Mastered Instinct, è il momento di eseguire una combo intenzionale.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Ordina al tuo Cu Sith di usare <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Trick<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, quindi usa l'azione del domatore <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Mistral Axe<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> per completare una combo intenzionale <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Moonstalker<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Da questo momento avrai sette secondi per completare la combo infinitiva.<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> Sbrigati!

40.name: Step Three: Use Rally to Accumulate 250 TP
40.translation_name: Passo Tre: Usa Rally per Accumulare 250 TP
40.description: Execute <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Rally<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> to spend all three stacks of Mastered Instinct and instantly gain 250 TP. Reaching 250 TP will change your four instinctual skills to those with affinities of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Sunstrider<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> or <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Moonstalker<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
40.translation_description: Usa <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Rally<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> per consumare tutti e tre i cumuli di Mastered Instinct e ottenere subito 250 TP. Raggiunti i 250 TP, le tue quattro tecniche istintive cambieranno e acquisiranno le affinità <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Sunstrider<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> o <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Moonstalker<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

41.name: Step Four: Complete the Infinitive Combo (Universality)
41.translation_name: Passo Quattro: Completa la Combo Infinitiva (Universality)
41.description: Since you gained the effect of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Moonstalker<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> in step two, you must execute either <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Brutal Rage<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> or <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Risen Fall<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, as both weaponskills have a <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Sunstrider<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> affinity. <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>An applicable action must be executed within seven seconds of completing the previous intentional combo.<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103><hex:02100103>In other words, chaining the instinctual affinities <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Moonstalker<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Sunstrider<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (or vice versa) will complete a <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Universality<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> infinitive combo!
41.translation_description: Dato che al passo due hai ottenuto l'effetto <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Moonstalker<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, devi usare <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Brutal Rage<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> o <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Risen Fall<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, entrambe con affinità <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Sunstrider<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Devi usare un'azione compatibile entro sette secondi dal completamento della combo intenzionale precedente.<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103><hex:02100103>In altre parole, concatenando le affinità istintive <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Moonstalker<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Sunstrider<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> (o viceversa) completerai una combo infinitiva <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Universality<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

42.name: To Summarize...
42.description: 1. Accumulate three stacks of <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Mastered Instinct<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.<hex:02100103>2. Complete a <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Moonstalker<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> intentional combo.<hex:02100103>3. Use <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Rally<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> to gain 250 TP, thereby changing your beastmaster instinctual skills.<hex:02100103>4. Execute an instinctual skill with a <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Sunstrider<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> affinity.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>You may complete infinitive combos with any familiar and initiate with either <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Moonstalker<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> or <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Sunstrider<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> affinities. In other words, illuminating your entire Inner Compass will achieve <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Universality<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
42.translation_description: 1. Accumula tre cumuli di <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Mastered Instinct<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.<hex:02100103>2. Completa una combo intenzionale <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Moonstalker<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.<hex:02100103>3. Usa <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Rally<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> per ottenere 250 TP e trasformare le tecniche istintive del domatore.<hex:02100103>4. Usa una tecnica istintiva con affinità <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Sunstrider<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Puoi completare combo infinitive con qualsiasi familiar e iniziare con un'affinità <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Moonstalker<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> o <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Sunstrider<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. In altre parole, illuminando l'intera Bussola Interiore otterrai <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Universality<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

43.name: Mastering Beastmastery
43.description: Infinitive combos are considered the pinnacle of cooperation between beastmaster and familiar, as they unleash the potential of both <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Sunstrider<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Moonstalker<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> affinities.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>The infinitive combo <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Universality<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> is the most potent attack in a beastmaster's arsenal, so advanced practitioners are encouraged to bring this power to bear when facing challenging foes.
43.translation_description: Le combo infinitive rappresentano il culmine della collaborazione tra il domatore e il suo familiar, perché liberano il potenziale delle affinità <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Sunstrider<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Moonstalker<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>La combo infinitiva <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>Universality<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> è l'attacco più potente nell'arsenale del domatore; chi ha esperienza dovrebbe ricorrervi contro avversari temibili.
